---
title: "Overview"
---

```{r}
setup_path <- if (file.exists("R/setup.R")) "R/setup.R" else "../R/setup.R"
source(setup_path)
```

Selected background items and scale sums for the `r survey$n` young people who agreed to take part. `r survey$n_declined` people in `r survey$file` declined and are not included. Item charts stay on the other pages.

```{r}
#| fig-height: 3.4

```
